faq.response_time_q: How quickly will I receive a response?
faq.response_time_a: We typically respond to all inquiries within 24 hours during business days. For urgent matters, we recommend contacting us via WhatsApp for immediate assistance.
faq.visit_factory_a: Yes, we welcome clients to visit our facility. Please contact us in advance to schedule a visit, and we can arrange factory tours and face-to-face meetings.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our services
faq.contact_description: Our team is here to help. Contact us for personalized assistance.

items.question: What is your minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
items.answer: Our MOQ varies by product type. For standard products, MOQ starts from 1,000 pieces. For custom OEM orders, the minimum is typically 3,000 pieces depending on the complexity of customization required.

items.question: What certifications do you have?
items.answer: We hold multiple international certifications including HACCP, ISO22000, BRC Grade A, Halal, and FDA registration. All our products meet strict international food safety standards.

items.question: Can I get samples before placing an order?
items.answer: Yes, we provide samples for quality evaluation. Standard samples are free (you pay shipping), and custom samples require a mold fee which is refundable upon placing a bulk order.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We accept T/T (bank transfer), L/C (Letter of Credit), PayPal for sample orders, and Western Union. Payment terms are typically 30% deposit and 70% before shipment.

items.question: How do I place an order?
items.answer: You can submit an inquiry through our website, email us directly, or contact us via WhatsApp. Our sales team will respond within 24 hours with a quote and order confirmation process.

items.question: What is your lead time?
items.answer: Standard orders: 2-3 weeks after deposit confirmation. Custom OEM orders: 4-6 weeks depending on complexity. Rush orders may be available for an additional fee.

items.question: Can I modify my order after it's placed?
items.answer: Modifications are possible within 48 hours of order confirmation, provided production hasn't started. Once production begins, changes may incur additional costs.

items.question: What OEM services do you offer?
items.answer: We offer full OEM/ODM services including custom formula development, private label packaging, custom shapes and flavors, branded packaging design, and turnkey solutions from concept to delivery.

items.question: What is the MOQ for custom OEM orders?
items.answer: Custom OEM orders start at 3,000 pieces per SKU. For complex custom molds or unique formulations, higher MOQs may apply. We can discuss specific requirements for your project.

items.question: How long does custom product development take?
items.answer: Custom formulation: 2-4 weeks. Mold creation: 3-5 weeks. Packaging design: 1-2 weeks. Full production: 4-6 weeks after sample approval. Total timeline is typically 8-12 weeks for new OEM products.

items.question: Do you provide design services for packaging?
items.answer: Yes, we have an in-house design team that can create packaging designs, logos, and branding elements. Design services are included for orders meeting minimum quantity requirements.

items.question: What shipping methods do you offer?
items.answer: We offer sea freight (FCL/LCL), air freight, and express courier (DHL, FedEx, UPS). Sea freight is most economical for large orders, while air and express are faster for smaller quantities.

items.question: Do you ship worldwide?
items.answer: Yes, we ship to over 50 countries worldwide. We have experience with various import regulations and can provide necessary documentation for customs clearance.

items.question: What are the shipping costs?
items.answer: Shipping costs depend on order volume, destination, and shipping method. We provide detailed quotes including shipping costs. For large orders, we can offer competitive freight rates through our logistics partners.

items.question: Can you handle customs clearance?
items.answer: We provide all necessary export documentation (commercial invoice, packing list, certificates of origin, health certificates). For import clearance, we work with experienced freight forwarders who can assist at destination ports.
